title: Dashboard telemetry reconciliation: missing metric series and broken trace links across Hosted/Dedicated/Private during incident
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple customers across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments reported missing time-series on Console dashboards and broken trace links during a capacity autoscaling event. Symptoms included empty charts for request_latency and token_count, dashboards failing to load historic buckets, and linkouts from a trace summary widget returning 404s. Impact: production-visible monitoring gaps prevented timely detection and routing of degraded model variants for several customers and triggered 4 severity-2 escalations. Root cause hypothesis: transient partitioning in the metrics-routing layer + an index alias race in the time-series storage after rapid autoscaler-driven shard redistribution. Immediate remediation: reverted the recent metrics-router rollout, applied a hotfix to make shard reassignments idempotent, and reingested 12 hours of missing telemetry for affected tenants. Longer-term actions: add versioned metric stream aliases, dashboard unit/regression tests, synthetic telemetry canaries for autoscaling events, and end-to-end trace-link contract tests. See attachments for links to PR, postmortem draft, and backfill job details.
